meaning:
ἐκ-δοχή ῆς, ἡ
(ἐκδέχομαι);
1. in cl.,
(a) a receiving from, succession;
(b) an interpretation.
2. In NT, = προσδοκία, expectation: Heb.10:27 (cf. Field, Notes, 231; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
